content: NestJS gateway lifecycle: afterInit() fires once on server init, handleConnection() fires per client connect. handleConnection is a framework-reserved method name in NestJS gateways (undocumented) — a naming collision with a custom method silently breaks message routing. No built-in mutex between connection accept and first subscribe event, so snapshot-then-subscribe ordering must be handled explicitly by the app (state read must happen inside handleConnection/subscribe handler synchronously with room join, not after).
